items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: I. Thomas Parker, you ever heard of? Leonard Parker. Leonard Parker. You ever heard of Leonard Parker?

ctx.x: There was a Trump McLeod from Slidell. He used to play with a lot too. He used to work through Mississippi and he used to send for Samuel Penn and I. Thomas Parker, you ever heard of? Leonard Parker. Leonard Parker. You ever heard of Leonard Parker? Sure, George Lewis used to play with him. I know he's better too. And I knew Dan Moody. Dan Moody used to be in a band too.
He mentioned him. What kind of trumpet did he play? He was good. Something like Kid Thomas? Well, I think he was better.
